turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Our water is so hard the kettle looks like it's full of snow. Is there a kettle that deals with that?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Some come with a built in limescale filter at the spout, which stops the flakes getting in your tea.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Does that stop the build up though?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not really, it just catches the bits. To stop the crust you'll want to descale it every few weeks.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Those work, or just boil half water and half white vinegar, leave it an hour, then rinse and boil fresh water twice.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My tea will taste of vinegar.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not if you rinse properly. And a stainless steel kettle with a hidden element is much easier to clean than one with a coil inside.
